jobs.description: Zelfstandig werkende kok We zijn een Japanse/Chinese all you can eat restaurant dat op zoek is naar een zelfstandige kok die ons team kan versterken. Als zelfstandig werkende kok heb jij een belangrijke rol binnen ons bedrijf. Je ontwikkelt en bereidt Japanse en Chinese gerechten en je zorgt daarnaast voor de continuïteit en waarborging van onze originele authentieke recepturen. Tijdens het werk, werk je vooral alleen met ondersteuning van één of twee hulpkrachten. Enige voorkennis en ervaring over de technieken binnen de Japanse en Chinese keuken zorgt voor een snellere inwerkperiode maar is zeker geen vereiste. Je bent dan flexibel en durft het om eventueel nieuwe methodes, technieken en recepturen te leren. English description below We are a Japanese/Chinese all-you-can-eat restaurant looking for an independent cook to strengthen our team. As an independent cook, you will have an important role within our company. You will develop and prepare Japanese and Chinese dishes and also ensure the continuity and preservation of our original authentic recipes. During the work, you will primarily work alone with the support of one or two assistants. Some prior knowledge and experience with techniques in Japanese and Chinese cuisine will lead to a quicker onboarding period, but it is definitely not a requirement. You are flexible and willing to learn new methods, techniques, and recipes if you don’t have the beforementioned knowledge and experience. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden- Toezien op en bereiden van gerechten: De kwaliteit van te gebruiken producten en ingrediënten beoordelen en klaarzetten. Vervolgens werk je aan de voorbereiding zoals wassen, snijden, mengen etc. Tussentijds doe je kwaliteitscontroles op gaarheid, smaak, kleur, vloeibaarheid etc. en stel je bij indien nodig. Tot slot maak je de bestellingen doorgeefgereed. Hierbij zorg je ervoor dat alle HACCP voorschriften zijn nageleefd en dat het werk wordt gecontroleerd en gecorrigeerd van de hulpkrachten;.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to join a long-term project focused on the development, maintenance, and modernization of a large-scale business-critical application ecosystem. The platform handles high volumes of sensitive data, integrates with multiple external systems, and operates in a highly available production environment.
Key responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications across the full technology stack.

• Develop and integrate REST APIs.

• Maintain and evolve complex legacy applications while ensuring stability and service continuity.

• Contribute to the migration from legacy technologies (PHP 5.6/7.4, CodeIgniter, AngularJS, JQuery) towards a modern stack based on PHP 8.2+, Laravel, and Vue.js.

• Improve application architecture, code quality, security, and maintainability.

• Participate in technical analysis, troubleshooting, code reviews, testing, and documentation.

• Collaborate closely with developers, analysts, UX/UI specialists, and project stakeholders within an Agile environment.

Additional information

• Professional English required.

• Long-term assignment with renewable contracts.

• Up to 3 days of remote work per week.

• Occasional on-site visits to operational environments and end users.

• Opportunity to work on applications with direct business impact and visibility.

• Strong experience with PHP and modern JavaScript.

• Solid knowledge of a modern PHP framework (Laravel preferred, Symfony also welcomed).

• Experience with a modern frontend framework (Vue.js is a plus).

• Comfortable working across both backend and frontend development.

• Strong understanding of SQL, REST APIs, GIT, and software development best practices.

• Proven experience maintaining and modernizing legacy applications in production environments.

• Ability to identify and remediate security issues in existing codebases.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Technical environment:

• Current stack: PHP 5.6/7.4, CodeIgniter, Smarty, AngularJS, JQuery

• Target stack: PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12+, Vue 3, JavaScript

• Database: PostgreSQL

• Version Control: GIT / GitLab

• Containers: Docker / Podman

• Operating Systems: Linux / Red Hat Enterprise Linux

• CI/CD: Modern CI/CD practices and tools

Nice to have:

• Experience with Laravel and/or Vue.js.

• Background in application modernization and legacy migration projects.

• Knowledge of application security best practices.

• Experience working on high-availability or mission-critical systems.

• Exposure to Symfony, React, Angular, or similar technologies.

Responsibilities

• Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for the network design and inventory domain.
• Own and prioritize the product backlog while translating strategic objectives into actionable team goals.
• Lead and coach a multidisciplinary team of analysts and developers, including vendor resources.
• Manage relationships with external delivery partners and vendors to drive delivery excellence.
• Align stakeholders across complex business domains to manage competing priorities effectively.
• Contribute to application modernization initiatives involving cloud adoption and automation practices.

Requirements

• You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Lead, or in a similar leadership role.
• You possess proven experience in people management and leading multidisciplinary technical teams.
• You have a strong background in Agile methodologies and vendor management.
• You're experienced in working within complex enterprise environments and managing diverse stakeholders.
• You possess the ability to build and communicate a clear, long-term product vision.
• You have experience working closely with software developers and technical analysts.
• You bring a Master's degree or equivalent through professional experience.
• You are proactive and possess strong strategic thinking skills.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in telecom, utilities, or engineering infrastructure environments.
• Familiarity with fiber, HFC, OSS/BSS, or Physical Network Inventory tooling.
• Knowledge of modernization initiatives involving Cloud, CI/CD, and test automation.
• Proficiency in Dutch.

Responsibilities

• Translate business challenges into production-ready AI solutions for core processes including underwriting and fraud management.
• Guide data scientists in model deployment while ensuring adherence to high-quality security and governance standards.
• Design and build reliable data and inference pipelines, including CI/CD processes and observability frameworks.
• Lead the development of agentic solutions from proof-of-value to production using RAG and robust orchestration patterns.
• Define evaluation and testing frameworks, including red teaming and guardrails, to embed technical best practices.
• Advise product management on architectural choices, feasibility, and technical risks for AI initiatives.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions securely with internal systems via APIs.

Requirements

• 6+ years of experience in software or data engineering.
• 3+ years of experience as an AI, ML, or MLOps Engineer delivering production-grade solutions.
• You bring a strong background in technical leadership, including architecture choices, code reviews, and coaching.
• You possess advanced knowledge of Python and solid software engineering practices such as clean code and testing.
• You have expertise in AIOps and MLOps using Azure DevOps, Git, and Docker.
• You possess experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and container orchestration through Kubernetes or AKS.
• You have hands-on experience with Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, and Azure AI Search.
• You're familiar with agentic frameworks, RAG, Copilot Studio, and function calling.
• You are proactive, results-oriented, and able to communicate technical choices to non-technical stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English with basic knowledge of French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Vector Databases.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Accounts Team we are looking for a Customer Operations Manager (Jet Engines):The Customer Operations Manager leads the Shop Visit Managers and administrators within the Accounts team. This team consolidates the factory-wide operational status and plays a key role in ensuring transparent communication, coordination, and escalation management to support the efficient execution of engine shop visits.The Customer Operations Manager and his/her team are also responsible for the relationship, communication, and shop visit coordination with our external customers (airlines). He/she acts as the main point of contact for new customer onboarding, the management of complaints and disputes, and any other customer-related matters. He/she represents the customer and their contractual constraints internally within the shop.Your role:

• Lead and coordinate a team of Shop Visit Managers (engine owners), fostering performance, collaboration, and professional development.
• Oversee the work-in-progress status of all engine projects, ensuring adherence to commitments, schedules, and customer requirements.
• Act as the key interface between Operations, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, and the customer, ensuring clear communication and accurate reporting on project status and progress.
• Manage customer contractual constraints within the SAESB engine shop.
• Host customer visits, providing visibility on shop performance and ensuring a positive customer experience.
• Lead strategic projects aimed at improving engine induction and delivery processes.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing operational performance and customer feedback, with the goal of enhancing volume output and efficiency.

Your profile:

• You hold a master's degree in engineering with a strong business affinity, or a degree in Business/Economics with a strong technical affinity or equivalent by experience.
• You have strong business acumen and a results-driven mindset.
• Experience in the aerospace or aeronautical industry is considered a strong asset.
• You have at least 3 years of proven people management experience.
• You are an excellent communicator and are fluent in English. Good knowledge of Dutch and French is a strong asset.
• You possess strong interpersonal, stakeholder management, and representational skills.
• You have a strong customer-oriented mindset.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

This is consultative selling. Sales cycles typically run from 5 to 9 months, and up to 18 months with larger organisations. Your credibility with partners and senior advisors rests first on your understanding of their profession and of private wealth matters. Sales technique comes second.

We're a technology provider. Your role is to understand advisors' needs and the wealth issues they handle, not to advise their end clients.

• Work from an existing, qualified target list of firms and decision-makers in Flanders
• Lead in-depth discovery conversations with partners to understand their practice, their clients' wealth issues and their growth ambition.
• Translate these needs into concrete use cases for our company.

Pipeline and network

Collaboration

• Work closely with our VP Sales and our Revenue Team Lead
• Share field insights with Marketing and Product: client needs, objections, gaps What we are looking for
Essential

• In-depth knowledge of Belgian private wealth: succession and gift planning (including Flemish rules), matrimonial regimes, life insurance, holding and company structures, real estate, and the related tax aspects
• Professional experience in a wealth-related environment: private banking, wealth planning or management, insurance brokerage, estate planning, tax advice, accounting or notarial practice
• The ability to hold credible, substantive conversations with partners and senior advisor.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (our working language)
A strong plus

Personal qualities

 What we offer

The role ensures the stable, efficient and compliant operation of the UK business while supporting sustainable sales growth, market development and the expansion of the company's K-beauty activities in line with its European and global strategy.
Key Responsibilities
• Oversee the operation of stores, showrooms, pop-up locations and other offline sales channels in the UK, ensuring operational standards, service quality and customer experience.
• Manage local staffing, including recruitment, onboarding, training, work allocation, scheduling and performance follow-up.
• Develop and implement B2B and B2C sales strategies and identify new distributors, retailers, commercial partners and business opportunities in the UK market.
• Maintain and develop relationships with existing clients, distributors and strategic partners.
• Develop and implement annual and quarterly commercial and marketing plans in coordination with the European organisation and Korean headquarters.
• Plan and execute promotional campaigns, trade fairs, pop-up stores, customer events and partner events, including budget, logistics and performance evaluation.
• Conduct market research and monitor competitors, consumer trends, pricing, distribution developments and K-beauty market opportunities.
• Set sales targets and KPIs, monitor commercial performance and prepare regular management reports and recommendations.

• Experience planning and managing online and offline marketing campaigns, promotions or events
• Ability to update website content and manage basic website operations
• Ability to conduct market research, competitor analysis, consumer trend analysis and identify new business opportunities

• Experience participating in K-culture or K-content-related projects, such as international film festivals
• Experience supporting the international expansion, localisation or overseas marketing of Korean brands or Korean consumer products
• Qualification or practical experience in video production or video editing
• Understanding of and practical ability to work with photography, video, social media and digital content
• Experience using CMS or other website management systems

The candidate should also be able to connect sales, marketing, partner management and business operations through a strong understanding of the K-beauty industry and local consumer market, contributing to market expansion, revenue growth and the stable operation of the company's UK business.

Europe in the spotlight. You at the heart of the action.

Work alongside talented professionals from around the world and be part of an exciting, dynamic environment, contributing to the news and show production.

This versatile role offers the opportunity to be involved in every stage of production, from filming and editing to broadcast, both in Brussels and in the field. Your work will span a wide range of formats, including live shots, two-ways, news reports, interviews and programmes.

Filming and camera operation (field and studio)

• Filming reports, interviews, campaign rallies, candidate visits and vox pops, in Paris and across France.
• Shooting in fast-paced news conditions: sound recording, light-kit lighting, framing in challenging environments (crowds, rally venues, campaign HQs).

Editing and post-production

jobs.occupation: Researcher - PhD Candidate in Political Economy / International Relations (FRACTURE) M/W/X
jobs.description:
MAIN TASKS

• Conduct doctoral research in international relations, defence policy and international security.
• Develop the theoretical framework of the project, including an extensive review of the literature on alliances, strategic alignment, great-power competition and cooperation among revisionist powers.
• Collect, structure and analyse quantitative and qualitative data concerning the relations among China, Russia, Iran and North Korea.
• Develop a dataset covering cooperation in several domains, including economic, diplomatic, military and technological relations.
• Apply network analysis techniques to map and analyse the structure and evolution of cooperation among the four states.
• Produce network visualisations and quantitative indicators identifying patterns, central actors and asymmetries.
• Conduct qualitative and comparative case studies of episodes of cooperation, competition and geopolitical tension.
• Analyse the political, economic and strategic drivers of cooperation as well as structural asymmetries, dependencies and potential vulnerabilities.
• Contribute to scientific publications, working papers, policy briefs, blog posts and other dissemination outputs.
• Present research results at international academic conferences, RMA seminars and Defence-oriented events.
• Contribute to the activities of relevant academic and institutional research networks, including NATO-related research activities.
• Support knowledge transfer between academic research and Belgian Defence stakeholders.v 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Degree required / ideal degree:

Master's degree in Economics, Political Economy, International Relations, Political Science, or a related field.

This position is open to junior or early-career researchers (0-3 years of experience).

The position is intended for a researcher interested in pursuing a PhD trajectory within the framework of the FRACTURE project.

 

MUST HAVE

• Strong background in political economy, international relations, or related fields 
• Ability to analyse complex geopolitical and international security issues.
• Strong analytical and academic writing skills.
• Ability and motivation to conduct independent scientific research.
• Interest in both quantitative and qualitative research methods.
 

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with network analysis / data analysis tools (e.g. R, Python, Gephi, etc.) 
• Knowledge of the foreign and security policies of China, Russia, Iran and/or North Korea.
• Familiarity with alliance theory, strategic studies or defence policy.
• Experience working with international economic, diplomatic or security-related datasets.
• Experience with qualitative case-study research.
• Experience with policy-oriented or Defence-related research.
• Experience writing policy briefs or communicating research to non-academic audiences.
 

PERSONAL SKILLS

• Ability to work independently in a multidisciplinary research environment 
• Analytical, critical, and creative thinking 
• Clear and effective communication (oral and written) 
• Proactive, organized, and result-oriented 
• Strong team spirit and collaboration skills 
• High level of integrity and confidentiality
 

OTHER SKILLS

• Excellent command of English (oral and written) 
• Knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset 
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher may be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defence.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium for the duration of the study.
 
 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: From March 1st, 2027, in consultation with the applicant. 
• Status: Full-time employment based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant). Please note that your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to the funding project, which is guaranteed until 28/02/2031.
• Wage scale: class NA11 (holder of a Master's degree), with valuable/relevant seniority. A salary simulation can be done here : Simulateur de salaire. RMA-Patrimony applies a merit-based research career track, allowing researchers to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations.
• 
Holiday pay.

 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a SELOR test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€ / day);
• Digital allowance (15€ / month);
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days / week max);
• Holidays: 
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years) 
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).
